name: 15025 · Clairton, PA
findings: ZIP 15025 (Clairton) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15025 (Clairton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15025 (Clairton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
